prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production 2x2 square sprite sheet of a detailed male adult anime fitness guide for Gym Stone's Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch. Reference 1 is the prior detailed character artwork for face, build, black hair, warm skin rendering, red athletic tank, dark athletic shorts and red athletic shoes. Reference 2 shows the existing Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch at its top, use it only for the pose. Painterly cel-shading with small, clean highlights, anatomical detail, restrained outlines, realistic adult joints. Pure white backdrop, same fixed straight-on full-body camera, waist/hips/feet planted in precisely the same place in each cell, no zoom, pure white margin. Make each cell centered with generous 8 percent outer breathing room, square. Equal cells, no grids/text. Exactly four individually self-contained poses: TOP LEFT the athlete faces straight ahead and both arms hang comfortably. TOP RIGHT the athlete is halfway into the stretch, with THEIR right arm drawn horizontally across the upper chest toward the viewer's right, slight bend in the right elbow, their other hand moving up to support the upper arm near but above the elbow. BOTTOM LEFT the athlete has completed the stretch toward the viewer's right, right forearm still horizontal and pointing to viewer's right and still visible, left hand gently supports the right upper arm just above the elbow, left forearm angled up across the chest. BOTTOM RIGHT a true mirrored body action, from same still camera, left arm drawn across the chest toward the viewer's left, right hand supports the left upper arm near the elbow. Two arms and two hands only; keep both shoulders down and torso facing forward. The pants, legs, feet, shadows, and head should remain completely still through all cells. White margins between independent cells and no clipped features or background artifacts.

Use case: illustration-story. Produce a SQUARE 2x2 4-cell exercise sprite sheet for a male adult athlete. Equal square cells and no dividers, lettering or overlays. Each cell is separately centered relative to the same camera and precisely identical scale. Gym Stone Monster Walk. Same detailed character with red athletic tank, black shorts, red athletic shoes, dark hair and adult athletic anatomy as supplied style reference. Front three-quarter camera fixed in space, from in front and a little to the athlete’s right. White backdrop with a subtle pale-gray floor shadow. Athletic shallow squat with knees slightly bent outward, feet slightly wider than hips, hands on hips; one thin blue mini-loop resistance band visibly wrapped around both ankles in every pose, taut and entirely within each cell. Show a coherent four-pose cycle on the same shallow diagonal line: upper-left starting stance center, upper-right left foot steps diagonally forward and outward while right shoe remains grounded, bottom-left the other foot follows into the same width shallow squat while the left shoe supports, bottom-right right foot steps diagonally forward/out and left shoe holds. BOTH SHOES AND THE BAND ARE FULLY VISIBLE IN ALL PANELS, left and right margins 12% per panel and a lot of margin under feet. Pelvis translates modestly with the walk and does not flip or turn to camera, no new equipment. Use realistic anatomical proportions, clean line art and painterly highlight details in cloth, skin and shoes. Match the same person in all cells.

Use case: illustration-story. Produce a SQUARE 2x2 4-cell exercise sprite sheet for a male adult athlete. Equal square cells and no dividers, lettering or overlays. Each cell is separately centered relative to the same camera and precisely identical scale. Gym Stone Lateral Step-Up. Same detailed adult anime athlete with red tank and shoes, black shorts, dark hair and layered cel-shading as supplied style reference. Fixed straight-on full-body view with slight elevation looking down enough to see the rectangular gray aerobic step’s top. The SAME single low 6-inch (15 cm) aerobic step, horizontally oriented, in the exact same location screen RIGHT in every panel, dimensions 30% panel width and 7% of full standing athlete height. Athlete faces straight forward in all panels, hands lightly at hips for clarity. TOP LEFT both feet on the floor left of step, close to it. TOP RIGHT their foot closest to the box is lifted laterally and planted flat on top of the box, knee naturally bent, other foot firmly on the floor. BOTTOM LEFT athlete pushes through the foot on box and rises vertically, body weight now directly above planted shoe, planted knee partly extending, opposite shoe is just lifting from the ground to the LEFT of the box. BOTTOM RIGHT stands tall on the planted foot on step, lifted free foot hangs just off left edge of step. Two anatomically continuous legs and two shoes with clear separation. Stable step and completely visible feet, min 9% margin each edge, pure white, no grid, no perspective or orientation change. Use realistic anatomical proportions, clean line art and painterly highlight details in cloth, skin and shoes. Match the same person in all cells.
